#!/bin/zsh
# Diffs each example's output between `php -n` and the compiled elephc binary.
# Runs each in a private copy of its own directory so file-writing examples cannot collide.
ROOT=/Users/guillaumeloulier/PhpstormProjects/oss/elephc/.claude/worktrees/streams-csv-signature
WORK=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guillaumeloulier-PhpstormProjects-oss-elephc--claude-worktrees-streams-csv-signature/c8dbe38f-1f79-484f-9b83-62bacab9ca56/scratchpad/sweepwork
rm -rf $WORK; mkdir -p $WORK
same=0; differ=0; phpfail=0; buildfail=0
for d in $ROOT/examples/*/; do
  name=$(basename $d)
  [ -f "$d/main.php" ] || continue
  rm -rf $WORK/$name; cp -R $d $WORK/$name
  cd $WORK/$name
  timeout 20 php -n main.php > php.out 2>&1
  pstatus=$?
  if [ $pstatus -ne 0 ]; then phpfail=$((phpfail+1)); echo "PHPFAIL $name"; continue; fi
  rm -f main
  timeout 120 $ROOT/target/debug/elephc build main.php -o main > build.log 2>&1
  if [ ! -x ./main ]; then buildfail=$((buildfail+1)); echo "BUILDFAIL $name"; continue; fi
  timeout 20 ./main > el.out 2>&1
  if cmp -s php.out el.out; then same=$((same+1)); else differ=$((differ+1)); echo "DIFFER $name"; fi
done
echo "== same=$same differ=$differ phpfail=$phpfail buildfail=$buildfail"
EOF
